generated_by: npm run tools:export — do not edit by hand

webhook.body: JSON object with the tool parameters below

tools.name: get_day_info
tools.description: Get what the catalogue doesn't hold for one study day: the lecturers and the agenda. The dates, hours, place and price are already in the catalogue - say those at once, without this tool. Before calling it, say one short sentence in the same turn (e.g. that you are checking), so the line is never silent. Use only a day_id from the catalogue.

day_id.description: Study day id from the closed catalogue in the prompt

tools.name: send_purchase_link
tools.description: Send the customer a purchase link for one study day, to the phone number on file. Call only after the customer agreed to receive a link. Never takes a phone number.

day_id.description: Study day id from the closed catalogue in the prompt

tools.name: schedule_callback
tools.description: Note the customer's request to be called back at the time they asked for ("in N minutes" -> in_minutes: N). It is a note for the team that calls back - you have no calendar and see no one's schedule. If the time is outside business hours, the response proposes an alternative - confirm it with the customer before ending.

requested_time.description: ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-11-17T15:10:00 (Asia/Jerusalem local time when no offset), exactly the hour and minutes the customer said - never rounded

in_minutes.description: When the customer says "in N minutes": just N. The server computes the time. Use instead of requested_time

tools.name: request_human
tools.description: Note that a human rep should call the customer back, at the time the customer chose (requested_time / in_minutes, or asap when they answered that any time is fine). Ask when first and wait for the answer: without a time the hand-off is not noted (except other). Reasons: wants a person, pays via a rep, company pays, asks for a discount, asks about another course (course_interest), or asks something that is not in the knowledge base (other). It is not a live transfer: the rep calls back the number on file - never ask for a phone number. With other, only that question goes to the rep: the call goes on (e.g. the link can still be sent).

reason.description: Why a human rep is needed

day_id.description: The study day the customer chose or talked about, if any (from the catalogue). Omit when none

requested_time.description: When the customer wants the rep to call back: ISO 8601 date-time (Asia/Jerusalem local time), exactly the hour and minutes they said - never rounded

in_minutes.description: When the customer says "in N minutes": just N. Use instead of requested_time

asap.description: Only after the customer ANSWERED that any time is fine ("לא משנה", "מתי שנוח"). Never before they answered

tools.name: end_call
tools.description: End the call. Its answer carries the closing sentence (say_he): say it word for word unless you already said a closing sentence; never hang up in silence, except on voicemail. Pass the reason: completed, not_interested, do_not_call (asked to be removed), voicemail (reached an answering machine - say nothing), already_registered, wrong_number.
